description: The 'dss_plugins_live' dataset provides comprehensive information about various plugins available in the Dataiku platform. Each entry in the dataset represents a plugin, detailing its unique identifier, label, version, author, and a description of its functionality. The dataset also includes metadata such as tags for categorization, project usages indicating where the plugin is applied, and a boolean flag to denote if the plugin is in development. Additionally, it tracks the total number of usages and provides a URL for more information. This dataset is particularly useful for developers and data scientists who are managing or utilizing plugins within Dataiku, as it offers insights into plugin deployment, popularity, and application across different projects. The inclusion of tags and project usage data allows for easy filtering and identification of plugins based on specific needs or project requirements.
shortDesc: Dataset of live Dataiku plugins with details and usage statistics.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each plugin, essential for tracking.

columns.name: label
columns.comment: Human-readable name of the plugin, useful for identification.

columns.name: version
columns.comment: Current version of the plugin, indicating updates and changes.

columns.name: author
columns.comment: Creator(s) of the plugin, providing attribution and contact.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Keywords categorizing the plugin, aiding in search and organization.

columns.name: description
columns.comment: Detailed explanation of the plugin's functionality and features.

columns.name: project_usages
columns.comment: List of projects using the plugin, showing application scope.

columns.name: isDev
columns.comment: Indicates if the plugin is in development, affecting stability.

columns.name: total_usages
